segments.motivation: To organize personal to-dos, ideas, and client work efficiently.
To manage and track shared tasks, coordinate team projects, and ensure clear communication.
To streamline project workflows, manage deadlines, and consolidate all project-related information.

benefits.claim: Trello provides a clear and intuitive visual overview of tasks and projects through its board-and-card system.
It keeps all task-related information, files, and communications in one accessible place.
The software simplifies task management and automates routine actions, saving time and effort.

frictions.claim: Trello may lack the depth and complexity required for highly intricate project management or large-scale enterprise use cases.
The system can become cumbersome or messy when managing a very large number of tasks, boards, or complex interdependencies.
While offering custom fields, the core board-and-card structure might feel restrictive for highly specific or non-standard workflows.
